parsed.public_message: Blue sets Green to enemy at t=500 and advances east along z=636-658 into the central ring. Blue remains neutral to Orange and White and keeps all units strictly within our central-west corridor (z<=658).

private_messages.Claude: Executing at t=500: GPT set to enemy, Claude and Grok kept neutral. Driving east along z=636-658 to (624-646, 636-658) with elephants and swordsmen in front to engage Green's western line as you strike (675,612) from the south. Coordinate focus fire on Green next pause.
private_messages.Grok: Executing at t=500: GPT set to enemy, Grok and Claude kept neutral. Pulling companions and healers south from z=668-669 into our z=636-658 lane and pushing east to (624-646, 636-658) against Green's western front while you strike from the north.

parsed.notes_to_self: Turn 17 (t=500s): Executed coordinated 3v1 strike on GPT with Claude (at 600,571) and Grok (at 606,706). Set GPT to enemy, kept Claude and Grok neutral. Ordered cohesive eastward advance into the dead-center final ring: vanguard (646,654), elephants (644,648), wardens (646,636), companions slightly behind at (636,658) so cavalry does not outrun elephants into pikes, Seleucus (move) to (628,646) for full-army aura coverage, archers to (624,644), and surgeons guarding hero. All units stay at z<=658 to respect Grok's z<670 boundary and secure the center (640,640) before the t=600s 90m ring shrink.
parsed.explanation: At t=500s, the three-way pact with Claude and Grok goes live: we set GPT to enemy while maintaining neutrality with Claude and Grok. Rather than letting our fast cavalry outrun our slow war elephants and Seleucus's hero aura, we advance in a compact combined-arms formation to the dead center of the map (x=624-646, z=636-658). This puts our entire army inside the final 90m ring and brings GPT's western front within immediate engagement range just as Claude and Grok close in from the south and north.
